title: FBI Vault & DOJ Epstein Disclosures
summary: FBI Vault collection (22 parts of investigative records); DOJ disclosure page; ~900 pages unsealed Jan 2024 from Giuffre v. Maxwell (depositions, emails, contact book). Feb 2025 'Phase 1' release was mostly already-public material. Under the Epstein Files Transparency Act, ~3.5M pages, ~2,000 videos and ~180,000 photos were released Dec 2025–Jan 2026. DOJ warned some circulating material may be fake or planted.
